We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.  

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

We understand that every home is unique, and so are your decorating aspirations. That's why our diverse range offers a variety of shapes, ensuring you find the ideal canvas for your festive vision. Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.

item.content:encoded:
Transform your home into a winter wonderland with our exquisite collection of Christmas trees, crafted for both unparalleled beauty and effortless convenience. We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.  

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

The Perfect Silhouette for Every Space and Style:

We understand that every home is unique, and so are your decorating aspirations. That's why our diverse range offers a variety of shapes, ensuring you find the ideal canvas for your festive vision. Classic Slim Sparse No matter which you choose, each tree is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, featuring realistic-looking needles and sturdy construction to last for many joyful seasons to come. Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.

item.title: Mixed Pine Promo Christmas Tree
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Transform your home into a winter wonderland with our exquisite collection of Christmas trees, crafted for both unparalleled beauty and effortless convenience. We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.  

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

The Perfect Silhouette for Every Space and Style:

We understand that every home is unique, and so are your decorating aspirations. That's why our diverse range offers a variety of shapes, ensuring you find the ideal canvas for your festive vision. Classic Slim Sparse No matter which you choose, each tree is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, featuring realistic-looking needles and sturdy construction to last for many joyful seasons to come. Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.
item.excerpt:encoded: Introducing the Mixed Pine Promo Christmas Tree, a delightful addition to your festive décor that seamlessly blends classic charm with robust design. This 7 ft tree is a picture-perfect symbol of the season that can be displayed in a variety of settings, whether indoors or in a sheltered outdoor area.

item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Transform your home into a winter wonderland with our exquisite collection of Christmas trees, crafted for both unparalleled beauty and effortless convenience. We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.  

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

The Perfect Silhouette for Every Space and Style:

We understand that every home is unique, and so are your decorating aspirations. That's why our diverse range offers a variety of shapes, ensuring you find the ideal canvas for your festive vision. Classic Slim Sparse No matter which you choose, each tree is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, featuring realistic-looking needles and sturdy construction to last for many joyful seasons to come. Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.

Transform your home into a winter wonderland with our exquisite collection of Christmas trees, crafted for both unparalleled beauty and effortless convenience. We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.  

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.

item.title: Alpine Balsam Fir Trees
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Transform your home into a winter wonderland with our exquisite collection of Christmas trees, crafted for both unparalleled beauty and effortless convenience. We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.  

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

The Perfect Silhouette for Every Space and Style:

We understand that every home is unique, and so are your decorating aspirations. That's why our diverse range offers a variety of shapes, ensuring you find the ideal canvas for your festive vision. Classic Slim Sparse No matter which you choose, each tree is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, featuring realistic-looking needles and sturdy construction to last for many joyful seasons to come. Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.
item.excerpt:encoded: Our rustic Alpine Balsam Fir takes inspiration from beautiful mountain evergreens. This slim Christmas tree is sparse by design, allowing you to decorate with your favourite ornaments for a festive yet elegant display befitting the season.

item.title: Hedgehog porcelain Christmas decoration
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Transform your home into a winter wonderland with our exquisite collection of Christmas trees, crafted for both unparalleled beauty and effortless convenience. We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.  

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

The Perfect Silhouette for Every Space and Style:

We understand that every home is unique, and so are your decorating aspirations. That's why our diverse range offers a variety of shapes, ensuring you find the ideal canvas for your festive vision. Classic Slim Sparse No matter which you choose, each tree is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, featuring realistic-looking needles and sturdy construction to last for many joyful seasons to come. Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.
item.excerpt:encoded: Adorably detailed and crafted in fine porcelain, this hedgehog adds woodland whimsy to your festive setup.

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Home/Page

We believe in the magic of Christmas all year round

What started as a small family tradition has grown into a joyful destination for festive enthusiasts everywhere. Our store is dedicated to bringing you the very best in Christmas decorations — from timeless classics to unique finds that spark wonder.

Every ornament, garland, and twinkling light in our collection is handpicked to help you create unforgettable holiday memories. Whether you’re decorating your first tree or continuing cherished traditions, we’re here to make your season brighter.

What people say?

Get this month’s curated collection of free design assets. Don't miss out on the latest high-quality resources available for download.

Every item I ordered was even more beautiful in person. I’ll definitely be shopping here again next!

Linda M. Vermont

Their decorations are unlike anything I’ve found in stores. I love the mix of rustic and elegant styles.

Marcus B. Illinois

I bought a wreath and a set of vintage-style ornaments, and I’m obsessed. The customer service was top-notch.

Tanya L. Oregon

Every item I ordered was even more beautiful in person. I’ll definitely be shopping here again next!

Harleigh D. Vermont
Show us your holiday coziness by adding #WoodMartChristmas on Instagram

item.title: Amanda paper star Christmas decoration 3-pack
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Transform your home into a winter wonderland with our exquisite collection of Christmas trees, crafted for both unparalleled beauty and effortless convenience. We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.  

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

The Perfect Silhouette for Every Space and Style:

We understand that every home is unique, and so are your decorating aspirations. That's why our diverse range offers a variety of shapes, ensuring you find the ideal canvas for your festive vision. Classic Slim Sparse No matter which you choose, each tree is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, featuring realistic-looking needles and sturdy construction to last for many joyful seasons to come. Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.
item.excerpt:encoded: Lightweight and eye-catching, these folded paper stars bring modern elegance in a convenient set of three.

item.title: Northlight Lighted Prancing Reindeer
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Transform your home into a winter wonderland with our exquisite collection of Christmas trees, crafted for both unparalleled beauty and effortless convenience. We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.  

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

The Perfect Silhouette for Every Space and Style:

We understand that every home is unique, and so are your decorating aspirations. That's why our diverse range offers a variety of shapes, ensuring you find the ideal canvas for your festive vision. Classic Slim Sparse No matter which you choose, each tree is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, featuring realistic-looking needles and sturdy construction to last for many joyful seasons to come. Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.
item.excerpt:encoded: Everyone loves reindeer for their magic and beauty. This beautifully crafted pre-lit reindeer will add the perfect dose of sparkle to your holiday.

item.title: Embracing Modern Styles: A Behind-the-Scenes Story of Fashion
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.

ClientWordPress
DesignerJohn Doe
MaterialsWood, Paper
Websitewoodmart.xtemos.com
View Project

item.title: Sustainability is the New Black
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.

ClientWordPress
DesignerJohn Doe
MaterialsWood, Paper
Websitewoodmart.xtemos.com
View Project

item.title: Digital Dress Code: How Social Media Shapes Your Wardrobe
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.

ClientWordPress
DesignerJohn Doe
MaterialsWood, Paper
Websitewoodmart.xtemos.com
View Project

item.title: Fast Fashion vs. Slow Style: Which Side Are You On?
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.

ClientWordPress
DesignerJohn Doe
MaterialsWood, Paper
Websitewoodmart.xtemos.com
View Project

item.title: A Brief History of Fashion
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.

ClientWordPress
DesignerJohn Doe
MaterialsWood, Paper
Websitewoodmart.xtemos.com

item.title: The Future of Fashion: Tech, Trends, and Total Transformation
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.

ClientWordPress
DesignerJohn Doe
MaterialsWood, Paper
Websitewoodmart.xtemos.com
View Project

item.title: Fast Fashion vs. Slow Style: Which Side Are You On?
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.

ClientWordPress
DesignerJohn Doe
MaterialsWood, Paper
Websitewoodmart.xtemos.com
View Project

item.title: A Brief History of Fashion
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.

ClientWordPress
DesignerJohn Doe
MaterialsWood, Paper
Websitewoodmart.xtemos.com
View Project

item.title: Embracing Modern Styles: A Behind-the-Scenes Story of Fashion
item.dc:creator: Mr. Mackay
item.content:encoded:
Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.

ClientWordPress
DesignerJohn Doe
MaterialsWood, Paper
Websitewoodmart.xtemos.com
View Project

$29.99

Perfect for indoor or outdoor use, they’re built to last through the season, offering a timeless look that complements any style of decor. Ideal for trees, roofs, or wreaths, these lights provide a warm and welcoming touch to your celebrations.

Add to compare Add to wishlist Share:

Fast Delivery

Quick, reliable shipping to any location.

Free & easy returns

Return this item by mail or in store within 90 days for a full refund.

Description Description Close

Transform your home into a winter wonderland with our exquisite collection of Christmas trees, crafted for both unparalleled beauty and effortless convenience. We believe the magic of the holidays should be spent with loved ones, not wrestling with complicated tree assembly, which is why our trees feature an intuitive, user-friendly design.

Effortless Setup for Instant Holiday Cheer:

Our innovative design boasts pre-attached, hinged branches that simply fall into place as you connect the tree sections. From box to breathtaking, you'll be amazed at how quickly your tree takes shape.

The Perfect Silhouette for Every Space and Style:

We understand that every home is unique, and so are your decorating aspirations. That's why our diverse range offers a variety of shapes, ensuring you find the ideal canvas for your festive vision.

Classic

Slim

Sparse

No matter which you choose, each tree is crafted with meticulous attention to detail, featuring realistic-looking needles and sturdy construction to last for many joyful seasons to come. Make this holiday season your most beautiful and stress-free yet with a Christmas tree that's as easy to set up as it is stunning to behold.

The Future of Fashion: Tech, Trends, and Total Transformation

Modern Apartment Interior Design

This project showcases a sleek and functional apartment interior that balances minimalist aesthetics with modern comfort. The design features natural materials, soft textures, and clean lines to create a warm, inviting atmosphere suitable for everyday living and relaxation.

01.

Smart Use of Space

65 m² of space optimized with multifunctional zones and integrated storage solutions

02.

Fast Turnaround

Completed in just 3 months—from initial concept sketches to final styling

03.

Custom Touches

12+ bespoke furniture elements designed specifically for the client’s lifestyle and space

Project Details

Details available with Every Demo

The main challenge in this project was transforming a compact layout into a bright, airy home without compromising on functionality. The designer focused on enhancing natural light, simplifying navigation between areas, and integrating storage in a seamless way.
